name: Butcombe Inns

source.title: Butcombe Inns 'Allergy Aware' menus: each pub's Ten Kites page with calories and allergens per dish (50 pubs read; viewthe.menu pages linked from butcombe.com/allergyaware; accessed 2026-10-09, no date shown)

note: Calories only, as printed beside each dish; the pages state no portion size. The pubs have no shared menu, so a dish is listed only if its name, calories and allergens are identical at every pub that prints it, and at 2 or more of the 50 pubs read. Not every pub serves every dish. Buffet tables, alcohol and hot drinks are not listed.
